name: em-rest-api-cpt
description: WordPress plugin — custom post type with REST API endpoints (POST, GET, DELETE), API key auth, and admin settings page.
author: Esmond Mccain

scripts.lint:php: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const walk=(dir)=>{for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})) { const full=path.join(dir,entry.name); if (entry.name === 'vendor' || entry.name === '.git' || entry.name === 'node_modules') continue; if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(full); else if (entry.name.endsWith('.php')) { try { require('child_process').execFileSync('php',['-l',full],{stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (error) { process.exitCode = 1; } } }}; walk(root);"
scripts.ci:check: npm run lint:php && npm run test:php
